data.gloss: trans. sich an jemanden/etwas erinnern, jemanden/etwas ins Gedächtnis rufen

rationale: Repeated mxaṭar-/mxaṭər- predicates contrast forgotten and recalled people, events and dates; direct nominal and suffixed stimuli establish one recall sense. The bracketed third-singular Preterit base is inferred from attested first-singular Mxaṭarli, not independently attested.

data.turoyo: <...> Emi bu Sayfo qṭəlulle lə kəmxaṭarnola.
data.translation: Uncle Isho: Sir, when I was little, there were me and my mother and three sisters. They killed my mother in the Sayfo. I have told you about it today, another time I told you about her. They killed my mother in the Sayfo; I do not remember her.

rationale: New recall sense and II Infectum cell; overt mother antecedent and feminine object -la. No edition translation is available.

data.turoyo: <...> Annaqqe lə kəmxaṭarnolle kulle. Anǧax zawno d oṯe l boli, kulle gəd mxaṭarnolle. <...>
data.translation: Many, many people died. I remember them all. Just now I do not call them all to mind. Only when the time comes to my mind, I shall recall them all. Many had died in Midyat. Barṣawmo Ruʕyo, he now has four or five (4–5) sons here. Many had died, Fatḥo and the others, my father and my uncle, they had all died. I remember these as a matter of course. Brahim of the Shabo family, the other one, the other one, all those who died I remember.

rationale: New II Infectum cell; negative indicative versus positive prospective recall with plural object. No edition translation is available.

data.turoyo: <...> lə kəmxaṭarno u medano. U medano mə zawno yo, hano. <...>
data.translation: Uncle Isho: Sir, the thing I am saying is old. Surely they were either lambs, or young bulls, or male kids... I do not recall this thing. This thing is from long ago, this. But I know we used to raise ewes, we used to raise rams, we used to raise young bulls, we used to raise heifer calves, and we would slaughter them as fattened livestock.

rationale: New II Infectum cell; zero-marked nominal stimulus without an object suffix. No edition translation is available.

data.turoyo: <...> Bas u Ḥabib dəb Stad u abro du Malke dəb Abrahəm, kəmxaṭarne. Hul əšqaḏ ste samwo. Hul d aṯino samwo.
data.translation: Uncle Ishoʕ: I am telling you what comes to my mind; many used to do it. I do not remember them. But Habib of the Stad family, the son of Malke of the Abraham family, I remember him. Until last year too he used to do it. Until I came away, he used to do it.

rationale: New II Infectum cell; positive recall of a named person with a contracted object form. No edition translation is available.

data.turoyo: <...> Tamo, huwwe dayəm aʕmi we. U sakratar diḏan di hayye we. Ṭaw meni kəmxaṭər i šatayḏa. Kibox mšaylət mene. <...>
data.translation: Uncle Isho: The year... my friend now, Gabro Haddodo, he is there in Norsborg. There, he was always with me. He was our secretary for these things. He remembers its year better than I do. You can ask him. I say the year... it was ’63 (1963), it was ’62 (1962), ’63, something like that; I am making an estimate.

rationale: New II Infectum cell; third-singular mxaṭər base, explicit year object and comparison with the speaker. No edition translation is available.

data.turoyo: Mxaṭarli u xabrano d Dawid, d mərle bu Mazmuro dam 132: "Lə kəbeno šanṯo l ʕayni, lo nʕoso laǧ ǧəfnayḏi, əlla ma d ḥuzeno bayto l Aloho, maskan du qadišo d Yaʕqub."
data.translation: This saying of David came to my mind, which he said in Psalm 132: “I will give no sleep to my eyes, nor slumber to my eyelids, until I find a house for God, a dwelling for the Holy One of Jacob.”

rationale: New II Preterit cell; first-person Mxaṭarli with explicit recalled saying, analysed without inventing experiencer inversion. No edition translation is available.
